name: temporal-16-complete
source:
---- MODULE Differential ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLE x
Init == x = 0
Next == x' = (x + 1) % 4
Live == \A p \in 1..16: [] (x < 4)
====
config:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
PROPERTY Live
CHECK_DEADLOCK FALSE
